section.46: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

46.name_native: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, that a Makhzumi woman used to borrow things then deny that she had borrowed them, so the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that her hand be cut off
